description: This file defines the AssignLeaveController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and includes a preRender method that sets up a leave assignment UI component.

classes.name: AssignLeaveController
classes.description: Controller responsible for assigning leave, extending AbstractVueController and setting a leave assignment component during pre-rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the leave-assign Vue component and sets it for rendering.
